source_evidence: Advisers generally must register with the Securities and Exchange Commission or state securities authorities.
answer: Before choosing an investment adviser, check whether the adviser is registered and review any legal or disciplinary history. Investor.gov’s search tool can help you find out whether the professional is licensed and registered and whether the firm or person has had regulatory run-ins or investor complaints. Check both the individual adviser and the firm. You can also ask whether either has been disciplined by a regulator and, if so, why and how the matter was resolved.
